init_fail_closed_change.rule: When MQL_TESTER && _MG_SelfGate, failure of MG_LoadRegime must return INIT_FAILED before any strategy execution. Live/non-tester behavior remains unchanged.

attempt_total = all pre-submit terminal dispositions + submit_total

denominator_instrumentation.instrumentation_gate: Emit qualification attempt telemetry only when MQL_TESTER && _MG_SelfGate; telemetry must not influence trading decisions.
denominator_instrumentation.semantic_preservation: Instrumentation records existing branches/results only. It must not add new order rejection or direction validation behavior.
